policy.canonicalSource: one source per tool and host; shadowed duplicates removed
policy.path: per-user bin dirs only (~/.cargo/bin, ~/.bun/bin, ~/.local/bin); PATH and profiles are owned by aphrody-claude user/shell, never edited here
policy.cargo: no Cargo build: toolchains via rustup, tools via cargo-binstall with compile strategy disabled

aphrodyArtifacts.note: aphrody-ovh is a library compiled into aphrody-infra; aphrody-ops and aphrody-workspace are Bun scripts under packages/infra/workspace and need a source checkout
aphrodyArtifacts.windowsBuild: APHRODY_LOCAL_CARGO=1 scripts/build/rust/cargo-serial.sh xwin build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -p aphrody-infra -p aphrody-kernel (integrator; factory route otherwise), installed to %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin

perHostExceptions.wsl: Ubuntu 24.04 apt is stale: ripgrep and eza via cargo-binstall, apt copies removed; jq/gh release binaries, apt jq removed
perHostExceptions.windows: winget user scope for jq, yq, carapace, zstd, wezterm nightly, gh, uv, zellij (Zellij.Zellij); binstall for the Rust set plus eza and ripgrep; rsync from MSYS2 (C:\msys64\usr\bin, shim ~/.local/bin/rsync.cmd puts msys usr/bin first so rsync uses msys ssh; C:\msys64\home\<user>\.ssh is a junction to the Windows ~/.ssh); pigz 2.8 compiled statically with MSYS2 ucrt64 gcc to ~/.local/bin/pigz.exe; OpenSSH Preview via elevated winget plus sftp.exe and ssh-keyscan.exe from the Win32-OpenSSH release zip into C:\Program Files\OpenSSH; ssh-agent service Automatic and running (elevated); claude via native installer (~/.local/bin/claude.exe); ovhcloud release binary plus ~/.ovh.conf copied from WSL; rclone via winget with remotes vps and dbfr (sftp over `ssh <host>`) in %APPDATA%\rclone\rclone.conf; user PATH gets ~/.local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, ~/.bun/bin
perHostExceptions.vps: jq stays apt (system scripts, minimal PATH)
perHostExceptions.dbfr: jq stays apt; no extra rust targets (12G free on /)

bunGlobalNote: wasm-pack is a bun global (prebuilt release binary downloaded by its npm package); cargo copy removed

bunHygiene.policy: newest stable Bun release at least 3 days old (bunfig minimumReleaseAge); every host applies the same rule

linux.schedule: daily 05:30 +-30m, user timer, linger enabled on vps and dbfr

steps: cache report, prune entries unused 30 days above 5 GB
frozen-lockfile dry-run in a temp copy (checkout hosts only)

sourceBuilds.pigz: https://github.com/madler/pigz (tag v2.8) with MSYS2 ucrt64 gcc -static

windowsTools.knownGap: ssh key github_aphrody_code is not registered on GitHub account aphrody-code (Permission denied); needs `gh auth refresh -h github.com -s admin:public_key` as aphrody-code then `gh ssh-key add`

sourceCheckoutHosts.remote: workspace (git@github.com:aphrody-labs/aphrody.git, blobless clone via forwarded agent)
